open: [P16] camera owns the last real object leak: game/view/camera/keybinds.gd keeps 35 InputEventKey/InputEventMouseButton in `static var _defaults` / `_overrides` and hands them to InputMap at line 450. They are the entire difference between a headless run (53 objects) and a windowed one (89).

[P16] camera also owns 9 of the 24 'resources still in use': statics in keybinds.gd, camera_services.gd (`static var _cache`) and game_camera.gd (`static var _current`). game/core/ui_layers.gd and game/core/sim_system.gd are in that list only because those camera scripts hold them — they go when [P16]'s do.
[P23] audio owns 13 of the 24: statics in game/audio/synth_recipes.gd (`static var _cache`) and game/audio/audio_bootstrap.gd. Same shape, same fix.

INTEGRATOR: tools/error_allowlist.txt is not mine to edit. exit_object_leak and exit_resource_leak now describe 53/24 rather than ~800/~260 and no longer grow while the game runs. Both entries want a `max_per_run` ratchet at the new numbers so the next regression is caught instead of absorbed, and their `why` text is now wrong where it says the leak cannot matter before exit — it grew by a world per save load.

INTEGRATOR / [P11]: build.rejected_total is still 13 against final_max 0. Untouched — HANDOFF 5 says the band is mis-specified and the choice between its three options is Maximilian's, not an agent's.

[P01] grid: GridSystem.find_path is unchanged and still spends its whole ceiling in one call. Anything else that calls it (combat, threat) still has the spike citizens no longer has. CitizenPathSearch is a drop-in resumable transcription of it and could move to game/sim/grid/ if [P01] wants one search instead of two.

PERF CAVEAT: measured on a shared four-core box with other agents active. Every reading above was gated on `ps -eo cmd | grep -c '[g]odot --'` being 0 before and after, and reported as a spread, but the integrator should re-measure alone before trusting any single number.
